be_module_repoint.AND_A_GAP_IN_MY_OWN_METHOD_CLOSED_HERE: DE 77's justification compared top-level DEFINITIONS only. THIS change moved NO definition at all -- it would have passed that check in silence. `ARMS` (both thetas), `SEED`, `N_DRAWS` and `COIN` are module-level ASSIGNMENTS, so a refitted theta or a changed seed is exactly the class of change that method could not see. Both axes are compared now, and the pinned constants are named and checked one by one
be_module_repoint.the_only_thing_that_moved: OUT_DERIVED, BE's WRITE root -- from `ROOT / 'data/pm_5min/derived'` to `_BDR.derived()`. DE's day path never uses it: it calls load, arm_stream, flagged_stream, replay, _alloc, draw_flags and draw_null, and never BE's run() or main()
be_module_repoint.why: the runner's own guard REFUSED on reload for the SECOND round running: BE's cascade changed at 68b34bd (round 50) and the pin was stale. The guard fired on a real change, which is what it is for

design_declaration.note: THE NAME CARRIES NO STAMP FROM v16. This path must be known BEFORE the design is emitted, because the params name it -- and a stamp that must be chosen in advance is a stamp somebody types. design v15's filename said 09:45:00Z for an artifact written at 09:32:50Z: a name for a moment that had not yet occurred. The version is the identity; the time lives in `as_of`, read from the clock.
design_declaration.sha256: NOT_PINNED_HERE -- the pin runs design -> params
design_declaration.why_v18_and_not_v17: `p003_de_multiday_gate1_design_v17.json` on disk carries protocol V16 -- the same version as `..._design_v16.json`, with a different params pin. From v18 the filename version, `protocol` and len(chain) + 1 are one number, and the emitter REFUSES an output name that disagrees (`assert_output_name_matches_version`, DE 90)

note: G IS DERIVED FROM len(days) AND IS NEVER A CONSTANT; `expected_G` below is a CROSS-CHECK the loader must satisfy, not the source of G. THE VERSION TRAVELS IN `version`; v1's protocol string said V2 while its filename said v1.

read_gate.ONE_FIELD: R-604 item 8 was LIVE in the landed artifacts: v7 carried the eight under `read_gate_predicate` while `read_gate.the_bar_is_a_CONJUNCTION` still listed R-602's TWO strings -- and DA 74 read the latter and reported '2 conjuncts declared'. Two fields, two implementations, silently different bars. There is ONE list now, of OBJECTS with stable ids, and both seats evaluate it by id
read_gate.a_conjunct_id_without_an_evaluator_CLOSE: as DA already does for an unknown string: a bar nobody evaluates is not a bar

at_the_horizon.declared_now_with_its_date: so the stopping rule is not a degree of freedom chosen after seeing which days landed
at_the_horizon.why: 2^-5 = 0.03125 is not significant at m = 2 -- the USER's own words

receipt_naming.composed_by: the RUNNER, at the moment of writing, from `emission_stamp()` -- NOT the caller. REV 55 S2.1: a launch-stamped name refuses at the emit by -5,074 s and a stamp-free name is invisible to this glob
receipt_naming.fixture_receipts: p003_de_gate1_day_run_<day>_FIXTURE__<stamp>.json -- cannot match the sealed glob at all
receipt_naming.output_argument: `--output` names the DIRECTORY the receipt is written into. A caller-supplied filename is REFUSED BEFORE ANY WORK, at zero draws
receipt_naming.resolved_by: PREFIX glob, with EXACTLY ONE match required -- zero is a day that never ran and two is a day that ran twice, which a read must refuse rather than resolve by picking the newest

the_bar_is_a_CONJUNCTION.text: now >= read_not_before_utc. A GENUINE conjunct: six receipts before the bar must NOT open the read
the six RULED days come from THIS file, never 'six receipts present' -- a receipt for another day fills no hole

each day's sealed receipt digest equals the one DA's pre-read recorded WHEN THE DAY LANDED; a re-run after landing REFUSES -- waiting must not become re-rolling. A superseding vN is admitted only when its chain reaches the landed digest
each day has >= 1 arm with admissibility.admissible true, read from the SEALED artifact. Six all-inadmissible days satisfy existence and contribute ZERO SIGNS
day_quality_pass AND era_pure AND counts_toward_race -- R-555's membership. A sealed receipt is DE's own artifact and is not a day verdict
producing_code_sha256 equals the runner's blob at the receipt's carrying_commit. For 2026-09-03 the .v2 supersession is what makes this hold: v1 was stamped from a file replaced mid-run (R-603)

if the sixth ruled day has not landed by horizon_utc the read opens at G = 5 over the five LANDED ruled days, DIRECTIONAL ONLY (2^-5 = 0.03125 is not significant at m = 2), with the sixth disclosed as UNBUILT
a params file lacking this list REFUSES before any day is examined. DA's gate reads the SAME field; two implementations of one bar must not disagree silently

read_gate.the_day_set_is_UNCHANGED: R-555 ruled the population; this rules only WHEN the read may open. Nothing is chosen on data
read_gate.why: DA 72 measured the pipeline at 1.165 h SERIAL per day (fragment 608.4 s + tape 1,471.6 s + book 2,115.7 s = 4,195.7 s), and the sixth ruled day 2026-09-08 completes by CALENDAR at 2026-09-09T00:00:00Z -- six minutes before the ruled read_not_before of 00:06Z. Under a clock bar alone the read would open on FIVE days, and G = 5 gives 2^-5 = 0.03125, which FAILS Holm at m = 2 by the design's own arithmetic

read_gate_predicate.why: one field, so the two seats cannot read different bars (R-604 item 8)

ruling.completion: the 2026-09-09T00:06Z verdict; the run does not start before it
ruling.if_a_future_day_fails_its_verdict: the set waits for the next qualifying CLOSED day in calendar order. G STAYS 6 and nothing is chosen
ruling.rule: the four ledger conjuncts AND day-quality, on COMPLETE days only, AND previously_opened_for == none
ruling.smoke_publishes: resource observations only; its economic fields are SEALED until all 6 days are complete
ruling.why_not_SET_A: SET A included 08-29, 09-01 and 09-02, whose previously_opened_for is development_read or interim_read_of_frozen_candidate. The USER ruled untouched days only

supersedes.why: design v19 declares R25 (the runner composes the day receipt's name from the clock; `--output` names a directory) and R26 (membership questions are asked of the uncapped path set). The design pin is a PATH, so a design bump moves it

supersession_link_definition.a_chain_head_is: the artifact no present file supersedes
supersession_link_definition.a_link_is: the PAIR {path, sha256} of the artifact superseded
supersession_link_definition.a_matching_digest_under_another_name: is a MOVED file and refuses by name
supersession_link_definition.why: DE resolved links by DIGEST and DA by NAME. Driven on the SAME bytes, exactly one seat refused -- and nothing declared which was right. Both seats read this definition now

timing.day_runs_allowed_for: any CLOSED, QUALIFYING day in the ruled set
timing.read_not_before_utc_governs: the AGGREGATE READ only: the unseal of the economic fields and the section-7 verdict
timing.why_it_was_wrong: one whole-set field did two jobs and read as a bar on every run. A per-day run is SEALED -- resources, counts and statuses, no economic field -- so it cannot inform a later choice, and holding 09-03 behind 2026-09-09 bought nothing and cost the calendar
